'''Shiba Inu''' token (ticker: '''SHIB''') is a [[Decentralized exchange|decentralized]] [[cryptocurrency]] created in August 2020 by an anonymous person or group using the pseudonym "Ryoshi".<ref name="fortune"/> It is inspired by the [[Shiba Inu]] (柴犬), a Japanese dog breed, which also serves as the mascot for [[Dogecoin]], another cryptocurrency with [[meme]] origins. Some categorize Shiba Inu as a "[[meme coin]]."<ref>{{cite news |last1=Kaul |first1=Abhinav |title=Experts say retail investors should stay away from 'War of Meme Coins' |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/cryptocurrency/experts-say-retail-investors-should-stay-away-from-war-of-meme-coins-11635421101353.html |access-date=1 November 2021 |work=[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]] |date=28 October 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Scribner |first1=Herb |title=Shiba Inu coin had another spike. But will it last? |url=https://www.deseret.com/2021/10/5/22710714/shiba-inu-coin-new-rise-success |access-date=1 November 2021 |work=[[Deseret News]] |date=5 October 2021}}</ref> Concerns have been expressed about the concentration of the coin with a single "whale" wallet controlling billions of dollars' worth of the token, as frenzied buying by retail investors took place around November 2021, motivated by [[fear of missing out]] (FOMO).<ref>{{cite news |last1=Regan |first1=Michael P. |title=Shiba Wallet With Billions Is Scrutinized as Coin Tumbles |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-11-03/shiba-whale-wallets-with-billions-hounded-by-crypto-detectives |access-date=7 November 2021 |work=Bloomberg |date=3 November 2021}}</ref> Shiba Inu was introduced with a branding that positioned it as a potential 'Dogecoin competitor'.<ref name="fortune" />

On 13 May 2021, [[Vitalik Buterin]] donated more than 50 trillion SHIB (worth over $1 billion at the time) to the India [[COVID-Crypto Relief Fund]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Vigna |first=Caitlin Ostroff and Paul |date=2021-05-13 |title=Ethereum Luminary Makes $1 Billion Covid-19 Gift—in Shiba Inu Token |language=en-US |work=Wall Street Journal |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/ethereum-luminary-makes-1-billion-covid-19-donationin-shiba-inu-coin-11620862550 |access-date=2021-05-13 |issn=0099-9660 |archive-date=2021-05-13 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210513000403/https://www.wsj.com/articles/ethereum-luminary-makes-1-billion-covid-19-donationin-shiba-inu-coin-11620862550 |url-status=live}}</ref> Also in May 2021, Buterin donated SHIB worth $665 million to the [[Future of Life Institute]], which focuses on regulating [[artificial intelligence]] to protect from [[Existential risk from artificial general intelligence|existential risk from advanced artificial intelligence]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=BORDELON |first=BRENDAN |date=2024-03-26 |title=The little-known AI group that got $660 million |url=https://www.politico.com/news/2024/03/25/a-665m-crypto-war-chest-roils-ai-safety-fight-00148621 |work=Politico}}</ref>

In October 2021, the market price of the cryptocurrency experienced a significant rise, reportedly increasing by 240% within a week.<ref>{{cite news |title=Shiba inu coin skyrockets after an Elon Musk tweet supercharges the token - taking weekly gains to 240% |url=https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/shiba-inu-coin-skyrockets-65-101528714.html |access-date=6 October 2021 |work=www.yahoo.com |archive-date=7 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211007000113/https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/shiba-inu-coin-skyrockets-65-101528714.html |url-status=live }}</ref> However, at the beginning of November, it faced a decline, reportedly losing approximately 55% of its value by the end of the month.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Yue |first1=Frances |title=A major crypto exchange's CEO is set on holding Shiba Inu crypto long term despite its recent tumble. Here's why |url=https://www.marketwatch.com/story/a-major-crypto-exchanges-ceo-is-set-on-holding-shiba-inu-crypto-long-term-despite-its-recent-tumble-heres-why-11636056485 |access-date=7 November 2021 |work=Market Watch |date=4 November 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Denton |first1=Jack |title=Shiba Inu Is Plunging. A Prominent Crypto Whale Is Making Waves. |url=https://www.barrons.com/articles/shiba-inu-coin-price-plunge-crypto-whale-51636030374 |access-date=7 November 2021 |work=Barron's |date=4 November 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Maishera |first1=Hassan |title=Shiba Inu Dips by 5% Despite Reaching 1 Million Holders |url=https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/shiba-inu-dips-5-despite-142821397.html |website=Yahoo! Sports UK |access-date=26 November 2021 |date=26 November 2021}}</ref>
